[Section] Conclusions
[source_id=23] We proposed an efficient model to structure an unordered document. We evaluated our model against the baseline and found that our proposed model has a significant improvement. We observed that while ordering an unordered document, the initial sentences associated with a keyword/topic play a significant role.
